'24x24' is the sprite dimension (semantic, not address residue); 'with_dialog_bg_fill' accurately captures the one behavioral difference from the passthrough sibling: the 0xC0..0xFF (high-bit-set + 0x40-set) mode fills the run with the constant dialog-background palette index 0x49 instead of doing a transparent skip. Decompilation confirms __cdecl, 3 params, void, call_count=0 (hand-written RLE leaf), immediate 0x49 fill. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Hand-written RLE blit of a 24x24 sprite into dst_buf, identical to fd2_tile_blit_24x24_passthrough except the transparent/skip mode fills the run with the constant dialog-background colour 0x49, erasing a portrait/sprite over a dialog panel to flat dialog background.
logic_summary: Decodes a one-command-byte-at-a-time RLE stream over 24 rows, x_remain starting at 0x18 (24) per row; after each row dst advances by stride-0x18. Command top two bits select mode, low 6 bits +1 = run length: 00=RUN (paint len pixels from one following source byte, dst+=len, x-=len); 01=STRIDE-2 RUN (paint len pixels from one following source byte at every other dst byte via INC EDI;STOSB so byte lands at odd offset, dst+=2*len, x-=2*len); 10=LITERAL (copy len following source bytes one dst byte each, dst+=len, x-=len); 11=DIALOG-BG FILL (write constant 0x49 for len bytes, no source consumed, dst+=len, x-=len). The RUN/STRIDE-2/LITERAL bodies are byte-for-byte the passthrough behaviour; only the 11-mode differs (passthrough skips transparently, this fills 0x49).

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride in bytes; the per-row reset advances dst by stride - 0x18 to reach the next row's first column.
params.reason: Accurately names the row pitch used to compute the row advance; matches body usage and decompiled param. No address residue.
